title: A finite morphism of schemes has property B
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies property (B) for a finite morphism of schemes (statement lines 5953-5957, with property (B) itself delivered verbatim as a context span from lines 5935-5947 because the statement refers to it by name). The proof combines two inputs: finiteness of the base change X x_Y V -> V, which makes the fibre over the given point v consist of finitely many points (proof lines 5970-5990), and the companion property for finite morphisms, applied at the points of that fibre (proof lines 5993-6023), which produces the etale neighbourhood and the disjoint union decomposition demanded by property (B). The non-formal content is the assembly of the finitely many local decompositions into the single neighbourhood required. The claim is H2: a short argument whose work is the finite bookkeeping over the fibre.
